acceptance_criteria: Minimum 15 test cases covering null-propagation scenarios
Test cases align with acceptance criteria in DSL-11 requirement
task.description: Create comprehensive test specification for DSL-11 (dot-path traversal) at tests/specs/DSL-11.md. Cover: simple two-level paths, deeply nested paths (3-5 levels), null at each nesting level, null-propagation with mixed types, error cases (invalid syntax, unsupported operators on null), and integration with existing DSL features (type coercion, function calls on path results).

result.summary: Created comprehensive test specification for DSL-11 with 44 test cases organized across 11 categories. Covers simple and nested paths, null-propagation at root/intermediate/missing-field levels, mixed types, error cases, and integration with DSL-05/DSL-10. Specification is ready for TEST-RUNNER implementation.
